items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: With the seven pieces. And George -- who did I say? George -- what was his name? The tenor player.

ctx.x: With the seven pieces. And George -- who did I say? George -- what was his name? The tenor player.
Oh, yeah. You did tell me. Well -- I don't know why it's gone out of my mind.
